svg.aria-label: 08:00 · The meeting. Lowsper. Open source · runs in the browser. During a meeting, Lowsper writes down everything that is said and tells the speakers apart. I walk out with what I need to write the minutes in two minutes. Nothing goes online: everything stays on the computer. Lowsper: two people talk and the transcript writes itself, offline
